description: Non-secret provider configuration. IDs are provisioned outside Codex. Auth configs must be reviewed for the listed read scope before enabling. Runtime permission policy remains the action authority.

vercel.label: Vercel
vercel.setup: Sign in to Vercel with Continue with Google at https://vercel.com/login. Provision a reviewed Vercel Composio auth config for metadata reads. No Vercel password is needed. No deployment tool is exposed.

github.label: GitHub website source
github.setup: The Example-Org organization currently refuses the existing Composio OAuth app (HTTP 403). An organization owner must approve read access to example-site, or supply an authorized read-only source export of commit 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. Do not change the existing account from Codex.

googledrive.label: Google Drive
googledrive.setup: Provision a separate, reviewed drive.readonly auth config. Google sign-in does not grant Drive access. Existing registered Studio Drive readers remain available through their current authorized paths.

gmail.label: Gmail
gmail.setup: Provision a separate, reviewed gmail.readonly auth config. Google sign-in does not grant Gmail access. Existing authorized David mail connectors remain unchanged.

website.source_evidence: Operator supplied Vercel-verified identity; local source object not yet available. Published deployment marker independently verified in Chromium.
